title: Battery module thermal management
abstract: A battery module includes features to optimize cooling while providing electrical isolation and cell gas-venting channels. The battery module can include the integration of a heatsink in order to improve thermal performance. Thermally conductive pads can be provided to create an electrically isolated interface between a plurality of series-connected battery-cell lead plates, at different potentials, and the heatsink.
quote: A battery module includes features to optimize cooling while providing electrical isolation and cell gas-venting channels.
